question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

BLINK
solution: The correct answer is "**flicker**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "Blink" means to close and open one's eyes quickly. • Example: He blinked his eyes several times to adjust to the bright light. • "**Attend**" means be present at (an event, meeting, or function). • **Example**: I **attended **his sister's wedding yesterday. • "**Flicker**" means **to shine unsteadily or to go on and off intermittently**. • **Example**: The candle **flickered **in the dark. • "**Blaze**" means **to burn brightly and intensely**. • **Example**: The fire **blazed **for hours before it was finally extinguished. • **"Shine**" means **to give out or reflect bright light**. • **Example**: The sun **shone **brightly in the sky • From the above meanings and examples we can conclude that the most appropriate **synonym **of "**blink**" should be "**flicker**" which means **to shine. unsteadily or to go on and off intermittently.** • Thus, ***option 2*** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • "Blink" का अर्थ है अपनी आँखें जल्दी से बंद करना और खोलना। • "Attend" का अर्थ है (एक घटना, बैठक या समारोह) में उपस्थित होना। • "Flicker" का अर्थ है अस्थिर रूप से चमकना या रुक-रुक कर चमकना। • "Blaze" का अर्थ है तेज और तीव्र रूप से जलना। • "Shine" का अर्थ है उज्ज्वल प्रकाश देना या प्रतिबिंबित करना। 3f:T8ea, The correct answer is "**Reading makes a man wise**"
